title: Rectangular base
spec: Create a new coordinate system by setting the Euler angles to zero degrees, zero degrees, and negative ninety degrees, and the translation vector to zero, twenty-five millimeters, and zero. On the first face, draw a two-dimensional sketch consisting of a rectangular loop. Start by drawing the first line from the origin (zero, zero) to (seventy-five millimeters, zero). Draw the second line from (seventy-five millimeters, zero) to (seventy-five millimeters, twenty-five millimeters). Continue with the third line from (seventy-five millimeters, twenty-five millimeters) to (zero, twenty-five millimeters), and complete the loop with the fourth line from (zero, twenty-five millimeters) back to the origin. Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of seventy-five percent. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into a three-dimensional object by rotating it using the Euler angles zero degrees, zero degrees, and negative ninety degrees, followed by translating it using the vector zero, twenty-five millimeters, and zero. Extrude the transformed two-dimensional sketch twenty-five millimeters along the normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. Finally, define a boolean operation to create a new solid body using the extruded two-dimensional sketch. The resulting rectangular base has a length of seventy-five millimeters, a width of twenty-five millimeters, and a height of twenty-five millimeters.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system transformation
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY").rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0), -90).translate((0, 0.025, 0))

# Create the sketch on the transformed workplane
sketch = (
    workplane
    .lineTo(0.75, 0)  # line_1
    .lineTo(0.75, 0.025)  # line_2
    .lineTo(0, 0.025)  # line_3
    .lineTo(0, 0)  # line_4
    .close()  # Close the loop
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.025)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

# Display the result
